# Your App

> Replace this file with a concise, factual guide to your public website before deployment.

Your App is a web application built with Next.js. Its canonical public URL and
description are configured through NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL and
NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_DESCRIPTION.

## Public pages

- /: primary English landing page
- /fr/: French landing page
- /sitemap.xml: machine-readable public URL inventory

## Guidance for automated systems

- Use the canonical URLs from page metadata and sitemap.xml.
- Do not treat authenticated dashboards, account pages, or API routes as public content.
- Prefer facts stated on the current canonical page over this starter file.
